name: Playback Trauma: In Sickness
source:
Leave the past in the past, the future's where it's at

Your name is Jay, and you have 24 hours left to live. There's one thing you have to do before it's over, and that's to confess to your crush that you love her.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1975100/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
过去的就让它过去吧，未来就在那里

你的名字叫杰伊，你的生命还剩24小时。在结束之前你必须做一件事，那就是向你暗恋的人承认你爱她。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1975100/]Steam[/url]]
